facts.claim: AIDAdiva (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2007; 69,203 GT; 2070 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 252 m length; Sphinx class.
AIDAdiva is a Sphinx-class cruise ship operated by the German cruise line AIDA Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: The first of the Sphinx class, revolutionizing the fleet with the open Theatrium concept instead of a traditional theater. Refreshed in 2025.
